crops.name: Rice

growing_guide.soilRequirement: Clayey loam to loamy soil with good water retention.
growing_guide.irrigationNeeds: Standing water 2-5 cm during vegetative and reproductive stages.

agronomic_risks: High moisture sensitivity: standing water (2–5 cm) required during vegetative and reproductive stages.
Blast susceptibility (Magnaporthe oryzae) under prolonged leaf wetness; excessive nitrogen increases risk.
Well adapted to lowlands; tolerates periodic field submergence.
crops.source_citation: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Agronomy Bulletin & State Agricultural University Package of Practices

crops.name: Maize
summary_reasons: Suitable for your soil and climate
detailed_reasons: High industrial & feed demand in regional markets

growing_guide.soilRequirement: Deep, fertile and well-drained loamy to sandy loam soils.
growing_guide.irrigationNeeds: Critical stages: knee-high, tasseling, and silking.

agronomic_risks: Severe waterlogging intolerance: excess root-zone moisture causes asphyxiation within 24–48 hours.
Northern Corn Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum) risk under humid conditions; requires well-drained loamy soil.
Critical water-sensitive stages: knee-high, tasseling, and silking.

crops.name: Wheat
detailed_reasons: Excellent rotational fit following Kharif rice
High regional MSP and mandi stability

growing_guide.sowingTime: First to third week of November.
growing_guide.irrigationNeeds: CRI (Crown Root Initiation) stage 21 days after sowing is critical.

agronomic_risks: CRI (Crown Root Initiation) irrigation at 21 days after sowing is critical for tillering.
Susceptible to Yellow/Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis) and terminal heat stress during late-grain filling.
Requires cooler temperatures (12°C–25°C); highly sensitive to early seasonal heat.
crops.source_citation: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Wheat Package of Practices
